name: manxome-armoire-without-the-ciel-bonus-cannot-activate
notes: The generated body gated its effect on the Ciel Bonus but the 'Banish self' cost was paid first, so a non-Ciel champion could throw the Armoire away for nothing. $activateAbilityPrereqs['fm894uc4ij:0'] now requires the bonus (same fix for Majestic Spirit's Crest, Melodious Flute, Flamelash Subduer, Mantle of the Abyss and Bise Blade).

engineBug.summary: Class/name-bonus activated abilities could be activated and paid for without the bonus.
